results.title: Cross-Module Privilege Escalation via Unverified Delegation Scope
results.status_reason: Model completed investigation and submitted findings.

investigator_result.demonstrated_impact: Vertical privilege escalation: An authenticated user can grant arbitrary role scopes ('admin') via signed delegation tokens, enabling execution of privileged operations (purge_all_audit_logs, override_system_configuration) in ExecutionEngine.
adjudication_reasons: Demonstrated impact substantiated: Vertical privilege escalation: An authenticated user can grant arbitrary role scopes ('admin') via signed delegation tokens, enabling execution of privileged operations (purge_all_audit_logs, override_system_configuration) in ExecutionEngine.

findings.title: Vertical Privilege Escalation via Unchecked Delegation Scope
findings.summary: The delegation endpoint accepts requested_role_scope without checking whether the caller holds that authority, allowing callers to grant themselves 'admin' privileges.

results.title: Asynchronous Queue Double-Claim Invariant Violation
results.status_reason: Model completed investigation and submitted findings.

investigator_result.demonstrated_impact: Financial loss via duplicate payouts: Concurrent refund requests for the same order are accepted and enqueued without an atomic reservation lock, triggering multiple external payment gateway transfers before ledger deduction occurs.
adjudication_reasons: Demonstrated impact substantiated: Financial loss via duplicate payouts: Concurrent refund requests for the same order are accepted and enqueued without an atomic reservation lock, triggering multiple external payment gateway transfers before ledger deduction occurs.

findings.title: Asynchronous Refund Double-Claim Invariant Violation
findings.summary: The refund endpoint dispatches jobs across an asynchronous queue boundary without establishing an atomic reservation lock, allowing concurrent requests to trigger duplicate refunds.

results.status_reason: Model completed investigation and submitted findings.

investigator_result.demonstrated_impact: Cross-tenant execution bundle substitution: Workload bundles are cached using a global cache key 'bundle:{spec_hash}' without tenant scoping. Tenant A can pre-seed a spec_hash whose entrypoint and environment are reused when Tenant B executes the same workload.

3. Tenant Beta submits legitimate workload with identical spec_hash 'spec_123'
4. Compiler reuses Tenant Alpha's cached bundle, executing Tenant Alpha code in Tenant Beta context

results.title: Multi-Tier Authorization Divergence via Public Bypass Controller
results.status_reason: Model completed investigation and submitted findings.

investigator_result.demonstrated_impact: Administrative authorization bypass: Sensitive user deletion service is protected by @admin_required in admin_controller.py but exposed without authorization in public_controller.py, allowing unauthenticated attackers to delete user accounts.
adjudication_reasons: Demonstrated impact substantiated: Administrative authorization bypass: Sensitive user deletion service is protected by @admin_required in admin_controller.py but exposed without authorization in public_controller.py, allowing unauthenticated attackers to delete user accounts.

findings.title: Missing Authorization on Sensitive User Deletion Bypass Route
